answer: Fingerprint escrow blocks bulk fakes. An agent locks 2x its 30-day earnings and files tasks, timing, peers as its fingerprint. Live work is tested over 20 epochs; a prism of checks splits history so copies diverge. An honest agent forges one record as water cuts a canyon. A forger with 100 copies pays 100 deposits, and a mismatch burns half each. 100 fakes cost more than duplicated rewards; one honest agent pays once, keeping undiluted rewards.
